newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, forwards, bonds paralyzed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, forwards, bonds paralyzed in late trade.

text.p: Greek interbank depos, forex forwards, bonds and forex markets were paralysed in late quiet dealings, traders said. Tuesday is a market holiday in Greece.
"The market is very calm in late trade," a foreign bank dealer said. "Trade has been negligible today and interest rates are unmoved."
The central bank drained overnight funds at an unchanged 11.90 percent.
Bonds were also steady and trading volume depressed, a foreign bank bond dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 157.53/63 from Monday's 157.565 fix, the dollar at 266.36/46 drachmas from 266.400 and the Ecu at 305.72/82 from 305.640 drachmas.
